subject: Post-call: POC qualification & SDK implementation playbook
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Matthew Gray <matthew.gray@clearwave.ai>, Aisha Malik <aisha@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: POC qualification & SDK implementation playbook

Hi Matthew / Aisha — thanks again for the call earlier. Below is a concise recap, proposed POC success criteria, and an initial implementation playbook for the trial environment so we can align on ownership and timelines. I've attached a short MD doc with the criteria and a draft schedule (poc-schedule.xlsx).

One-line summary
- Goal: Validate Clearwave's entity-resolution latency for population-scale queries using our hosted inference + streaming SDK (target 95th percentile latency <= 350ms per request) and confirm end-to-end token cost estimates for your 10M monthly inference mix.

Confirmed constraints from call
- Trial environment: Redwood hosted sandbox with dedicated trial token allotment.
- Data: sample dataset (anonymized) and streaming ingestion via your DataSync partner.
- Security: you requested SOC2 evidence and a short network diagram (attached: redwood-soc2-evidence.pdf).

Proposed success criteria (draft — please confirm):
1) Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end response time <= 350ms for core entity-resolution route on 1024 seq length under 10 TPS sustained.
2) Accuracy: Top-1 match precision >= 88% against your evaluation set.
3) Cost: per-1000-token inference cost estimate within 20% of our forecast.
4) Reliability: No more than 1% error rate over a 48-hour soak with your representative traffic pattern.

POC timeline & owners (week numbers are counted from kick-off):
- Week 0 (this week): finalize success criteria, legal/PS intake, send sandbox creds (Owner: Ben).
- Week 1: SDK integration + API route mapping (Owner: Soojin).
- Week 2: Streaming ingestion + KV/prefix cache tuning (Owner: Neha).
- Week 3: Load soak, metrics collection, and cost profiling (Owner: Soojin / Neha).
- Week 4: Acceptance run and handoff notes (All).

Implementation highlights / immediate asks for Clearwave
- Share the anonymized sample payloads and expected request shapes (Aisha).
- Confirm whether tool-calling (external database fetch during generation) is required during the POC. If yes, we will enable our function-calling shim for evaluation.
- Provide a point-of-contact for procurement (for trial contract and any needed NDA changes).

Technical approach (high level)
- SDK: use Redwood JS streaming SDK (we'll supply an example repo snippet). Route: /v1/generate/entity-resolve -> streaming tokens + function-call edges for optional DB lookups.
- API routes: we'll provide api-route-matrix.csv with recommended endpoints and param contracts.
- Instrumentation: enable token-level tracing in the sandbox for cost attribution (we'll send a tracing snippet to drop into your test harness).

Next steps (action items)
- Matthew/Aisha: confirm success criteria and whether function/tool calling is in scope by EOD Wed (12/9).
- Ben: start procurement thread and share trial SOW template.
- Soojin: share SDK example and API route matrix by tomorrow.
- Neha: block calendar for Week 2 to help with caching and performance tuning.

Attachments: poc-success-criteria.md, poc-schedule.xlsx, api-route-matrix.csv, redwood-soc2-evidence.pdf

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m follow-up if you want to walk the plan.

—
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Matthew Gray <matthew.gray@clearwave.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Malik <aisha@clearwave.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC qualification & SDK implementation playbook

Thanks, Soojin — this is a great summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Success criteria edits
- Latency: can we change target to P50 <= 120ms and P95 <= 350ms? P50 matters for interactive UX.
- Accuracy: we want a Top-3 recall >= 94% as well (Top-1 precision still useful but Top-3 recall is our primary acceptance gate).

2) Tool-calling: yes — during the POC we'll simulate DB lookups (we have a lightweight internal API). We expect the generation pipeline to call back for entity enrichment; can you confirm the SDK supports function-calling / streaming partial responses while waiting for DB responses?

3) Payloads: attaching a small sample (anonymized_sample_v1.json link in Drive). We'll send the full sample set by EOD Thursday.

4) Procurement: procurement contact is me for the POC (I will loop in legal if we need NDA adjustments).

If you can confirm the function-calling approach and share the SDK snippet today, we can align calendars for the Week 1 integration.

Subject: Re: Post-call: POC qualification & SDK implementation playbook

Thanks team — quick technical notes and an implementation checklist for Week 1/2: 

1) Function-calling / streaming behavior
- Redwood JS SDK supports streaming token deltas and a function-calling shim that will pause output while the SDK makes a blocking HTTP call to your enrichment API; the SDK buffers partial tokens so client UX remains responsive. We'll include a sample function handler in the example repo (link in Drive).

2) API route recommendations (see attached api-route-matrix.csv)
- /v1/generate/entity-resolve — main route (stream + function-call enabled).
- /v1/cache/kv-prefetch — optional warm cache endpoint we suggest calling during batch prep.

3) Dev tasks for Week 1 (owner in parens)
- Add SDK snippet to your test harness and validate streaming (Soojin).
- Wire sample payloads to route and verify schema (Aisha / Clearwave).
- Confirm enrichment API endpoint and auth model (Matthew).
- Enable tracing headers and validate token-level attribution (Neha).

4) Ramp plan for Week 3 soak
- Start at 1 TPS for 2 hours, then 5 TPS for 6 hours, then 10 TPS sustained for 24 hours. We will collect P50/P95, error rates, and token counts.

5) Logs & access
- We'll grant Clearwave a read-only dashboard link for the sandbox (expires at end of trial).

If everyone agrees, I'll prepare the dev-run checklist and calendar invites for the hands-on sessions.

Neha Kapoor
Customer Reliability Lead | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
